name: Akrivis Components and Tools
old_description: We supply hydro-cleaning systems, vapor degreasers, lead forming equipment, wire bonders, DI water systems, and other SMT manufacturing tools.
about:
Akrivis Components and Tools is based in Henderson, Nevada, and was established in 2023. The company was created to provide North American technical sales and support for specialized electronics manufacturing equipment, bridging the gap between overseas equipment builders and domestic manufacturers who need clearer communication, application review, installation, training, and service coordination.

The company does not manufacture equipment itself but acts as a specialized process-equipment distributor and application resource. It supplies hydro-cleaning systems, vapor degreasers, lead forming equipment, wire bonders, DI water systems, and other SMT manufacturing tools. Its focus categories include cleaning and contamination control, vapor degreasing, PCB/SMT cleaning, lead forming and cutting, lead reconditioning, component tinning, wire bonding, thermal/vacuum heating, and semiconductor packaging support. Akrivis provides installation, training, service, quote coordination, and application review from a Los Angeles-area support point, covering the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

The company serves electronics manufacturers, labs, and production teams in reliability-critical manufacturing, with explicit focus on aerospace and defense electronics and medical device electronics. Customers include those needing precision cleaning, lead forming for aerospace-style requirements, component tinning for defense electronics, and PCB cleaning for medical electronics.

Akrivis was started to address a support gap where specialized equipment categories are too complex for catalog-style distribution and too support-heavy for direct overseas purchase. The company emphasizes an application-first model, coordinating technical questions with manufacturers before quoting, and providing a North American point of contact for post-sale service, spare parts, and factory escalation.
